description: Change an item's metadata (description, tags, version, readonly, activated) and, with data, replace all of its data. To change only some of the data, use merge_item_data or patch_item_data. On a list with guard indexes, replacing the whole data would delete the values this token can't see, so it's refused unless overwriteGuarded is set. Pass the etag you read as ifMatch. 1 request (plus 1 to find the list's guard indexes, the first time).

data.description: Replaces all of the item's data

ifMatch.description: The etag you read the item with. The write only happens if nobody has changed the item since; otherwise it fails with ITEM_PRECONDITION_FAILED and nothing is written. Pass it whenever the write is based on something you read

item.description: The item: its id or alias value (a deleted item only by id)

list.description: The list: its id or pathName

overwriteGuarded.description: Write even though it replaces values hidden by guard indexes, deleting them. Only if the user means to

returnData.description: Return the item's data after the write (default: metadata only)

tags.description: Tags (at most 20). Replaces the existing tags

name: update_item
title: Update an item
